captures.label: sample-0
captures.query: WITH classified AS (SELECT t.id,t.session_id,t.tool_use_id,t.tool_name,t.started_at,t.outcome,t.command_summary,s.executor,CASE WHEN t.command_summary ~ '(^|[;&]) *df ' THEN 'capacity' WHEN t.command_summary ~ '(host-command|test-machine|ssh |aws logs)' THEN 'remote' WHEN t.command_summary ~ '(^|[;&]) *(cat|ls|stat|file|head|tail|wc|rg|grep|find|sed) ' THEN 'reader' WHEN t.command_summary ~ '(^|[;&]) *git ' THEN 'git' WHEN t.command_summary ~ '(^|[;&]) *(cp|mv|tee|touch|mkdir|rm|truncate) ' THEN 'writer' WHEN t.command_summary ~ 'python3?' THEN 'python' WHEN t.command_summary ~ 'yoke' THEN 'adapter' ELSE 'other' END AS family,CASE WHEN t.command_summary ~ '[<>]' THEN 'redirect' WHEN t.command_summary ~ '[;&|]' THEN 'compound' ELSE 'simple' END AS shape FROM session_tool_calls t LEFT JOIN harness_sessions s ON s.session_id=t.session_id WHERE t.id BETWEEN 820776 AND 974311 AND t.started_at >= '2026-09-24T16:32:33Z' AND t.started_at < '2026-10-08T16:32:33Z' AND t.tool_name='Bash' AND t.outcome IN ('completed','failed')), ranked AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY executor,family,shape,outcome ORDER BY id DESC) AS position,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY executor,family,shape,outcome) AS population FROM classified) SELECT id,session_id,tool_use_id,tool_name,started_at,outcome,command_summary,executor,family,shape,population FROM ranked WHERE position=1 AND id > 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
